The quota helper is `wouldExceedLimit(plan, resource, used, requested = 1)` in `src/config/plan-limits.ts`. Its doc comment reads "True when consuming `requested` more units would breach the quota." The neighbouring helpers (`getPlanLimits`, `getLimit`, `planAtLeast`) only read plan numbers or ordering, so they're out of scope.

Seven source files call it:

- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` (line 62, per-project issue cap)
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` (lines 95 and 137, usage check and plan-downgrade check)
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` (line 62, webhook cap)
- `src/server/services/attachment-service.ts` (line 70, storage cap)
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` (line 75, seat cap)
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts` (line 50, project cap)
- `src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts` (line 63, refuses a downgrade that would breach a current quota)

I left out files that only mention the name without calling it:

- Doc-comment or manifest references, such as `scripts/build-manifest.ts`, `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` and `corpus-manifest.json`.
- Test files that call it: `tests/config/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts` and `tests/services/invitation-service.test.ts` (the last one only in a comment).

The seat-limit banner and other billing components do not call it.

ANSWER: src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts
